sources.snippet: Version History ¶ v5: Minimum mujoco version is now 2.3.3. Fixed bug: increased the density of the object to be higher than air (related GitHub issue). Added default_camera_config argument, a dictionary for setting the mj_camera properties, mainly useful for custom environments.
